mapper.select: SELECT n.id, n.msg_id, m.msg_template_id, m.title, m.content, m.url, m.source_type, m.source_id, m.priority, m.owner_name, n.has_read, n.notice_time, n.read_time, m.send_time FROM sys_msg_notice n INNER JOIN sys_msg m ON n.msg_id = m.id WHERE n.msg_id = #{messageId} AND n.receiver_id = #{receiverId} AND m.deleted = 0
